hero.title: Connecting Brands with Strategic Markets.
hero.subtitle: HAG Partner LLC is a Florida-based B2B company helping brands, manufacturers, suppliers and distributors grow across export, distribution and digital commerce.

about.title: A commercial partner built for long-term growth.
about.body: HAG Partner LLC is a Florida-based B2B company supporting brands, manufacturers, suppliers and distributors with practical routes to market. We focus on sustainable commercial relationships, structured execution and growth across export, distribution and digital commerce channels.

channels.title: Three growth channels.
channels.intro: Each channel can operate independently or as part of an integrated expansion strategy.

cards.name: Export Solutions
cards.desc: Market expansion support for brands and suppliers seeking reliable international trade opportunities, structured coordination and commercial follow-through.

cards.name: Distribution Services
cards.desc: B2B distribution relationships designed to connect products with aligned buyers, operators and growth-focused commercial partners.

cards.name: E-commerce
cards.desc: Broad online sales channel development, omnichannel growth planning and scalable digital distribution without being limited to one marketplace.

why.title: A practical operating model for companies that value trust, clarity and consistent execution.

points.name: Strategic Partnerships
